batch_size.description: Batch Size for sampling of data by {@link KerasGenerator} for the model of {@link KerasPipe}.

shuffle.description: If true, shuffle the training data.

prefetchFileCount.description:
File count for prefetching of {@link Data.Persisted} by {@link KerasGenerator} for model
training or processing.

title:
This type represents a Keras data generator that can be used during training and processing of a {@link KerasPipe}.
A {@link KerasPipe} will, by default, use this base generator unless otherwise specified through a
{@link KerasConvertSpec}.

Please note that this base Keras Generator currently only supports input data of type {@link Data} and will return
Numpy NDarrays to the Keras model. To make our own extension of this Keras Generator to support your own input and
output data types, please see {@link KerasCustomGenerator}.
name: KerasGenerator
